entries.text: Verdant Crate registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the billing model of each item to that item's registered product record.
Verdant Seasonal Crate: a packed assortment of preserves and dry goods. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor an applicable billing model.

Registered product terms. Intended use: a single gift delivery to one address. Billing model: this crate enrols the buyer in a recurring quarterly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled.
